body.description: One election body. Only id, name, jurisdiction and sources are required: a body lists the facts the code reads from here, and the others stay where they were.

id.description: The body slug: its folder under data/elections-source/data/elections/ and the prefix of its election keys.

typeLabel.description: The kind of election, as the map app's candidate and party pages label it.

shortLabel.description: The body on a catalogue Elections row.

shelf.description: The catalogue's Elections shelf (src/catalogue/view-elections.js BODY_GROUPS id).

searchTerms.description: Words the catalogue search matches the body's elections by.

title.description: An election's title; {year} is its year.

wikipediaTitle.description: The English Wikipedia article on an election, where no resolved article is on file; {year} is its year.

wholeArea.description: Every election of the body is held over its whole area, so none is a by-election.

geography.description: The maps the body's elections are drawn on, each from a date (an election takes the latest rule on or before its date).

featureOverrides.description: A result's name -> the feature of the map it is drawn on, where the two are written differently.

dir.description: The folder of the area results, one subfolder per election date: an _constituencies.json index (its sourceMapId is the map that date's areas are drawn on) and one file per area.

modeId.description: The id of the election's geography mode that shows them.

labels.description: The geography mode's label in the map app, by the counting basis an election's _constituencies.json gives.
